"""User-visible cycle policy. Internal execution is silent by default."""

def cycle_boundary(
    *,
    material_cycle_complete=False,
    material_continuation=False,
    readback_complete=True,
    outcome_unknown=False,
    continuation_compacted=False,
    observable_local_result=False,
    next_frontier=False,
    auto_reentry_surface_observed=False,
    user_requested_progress=False,
    significant_milestone=False,
    important_finding_or_blocker=False,
    external_wait_transition=False,
    result_direction_changed=False,
    recovery_anchor_needed=False,
):
    if not (material_cycle_complete and material_continuation):
        return "SILENT_CONTINUE"

    visible = any((
        user_requested_progress,
        significant_milestone,
        important_finding_or_blocker,
        external_wait_transition,
        result_direction_changed,
        recovery_anchor_needed,
    ))
    if not visible:
        return "SILENT_CONTINUE"

    committed = (significant_milestone or recovery_anchor_needed) and all((
        readback_complete,
        not outcome_unknown,
        continuation_compacted,
        observable_local_result,
        next_frontier,
        auto_reentry_surface_observed,
    ))
    if committed:
        return "COMMITTED_CYCLE_AUTO_REENTER"
    return "VISIBLE_PROGRESS_AUTO_CONTINUE"
